title: feat(spec, plugin-chatbot, console): the AI model picker shows each model's cost multiplier and asks before a ×20 pick
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X6vxymhinbF5DrEZRbEU965)_

Fixes #33660

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

Seat `domain:ui#2` · os-project-manager · card thread `session_01FEkQ5pX4G6G9ZLeRqSRoFu` · claim 6890495150

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：AI 模型选择器（AI 对话页、控制台对话侧栏、Studio 助手三处共用）在每个模型名旁显示倍数「×N」；服务端提供用量时，下拉列表底部写明「AI 额度还剩 X%，标有 ×N 的模型消耗速度是默认模型的 N 倍」；选择 ×20 及以上的模型时先弹确认，取消则保持原模型，低于 ×20 照旧立即切换。接口定义 `AiModelsResponseSchema` 的模型条目新增可选字段 `costMultiplier`（正数，默认模型为 1）。
- 为什么改：维护者开放付费模型选择的条件是「只要选择时能够看清楚倍数」（cloud#4536）；此前选择器只显示名字。
- 风险与回滚：只新增可选字段与前端显示；服务端未填倍数时界面与今天一致。倍数由 cloud `service-ai` 的 `GET /api/v1/ai/models` 填写，那是另一张 cloud 卡（本卡为其 Blocked-by）。回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看：ui/packages/plugin-chatbot/src/ChatbotEnhanced.tsx（`ModelPicker`：×N、额度说明、×20 确认）、ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/ai/AiChatPage.tsx（`ChatPane` 读 `/ai/usage` 传给选择器）、packages/spec/src/api/protocol.zod.ts（新字段及其说明）。
- 两分钟验证：在提供多模型且 `/ai/models` 带 `costMultiplier` 的环境打开 `/ai/build`，展开模型下拉：每个模型旁有 ×N，底部有剩余额度说明；选 ×20 的模型会弹确认，点取消模型不变。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地（Clause-② 放宽，席位先补契约复审记录）。

## What changes

- **Spec.** `AiModelsResponseSchema` (`packages/spec/src/api/protocol.zod.ts`): the object form of a model entry gains `costMultiplier`, optional, `z.number().positive()`. Its `.describe()` says it is the factor by which one message on the model draws on the AI allowance compared with one on the environment's default model, states the normalisation as contract (the `default: true` entry carries 1; every other entry carries its model's cost weight divided by the default model's), and names its producer: cloud `service-ai`'s `GET /api/v1/ai/models`. The bare-string entry form is unchanged. The reference page `content/docs/references/api/protocol.mdx` is regenerated (`check:generated --fix`, docs only; `authorable-surface` did not move, so `Metadata-protocol: none`).
- **Producer.** Nothing in this repository answers `/ai/models`: `packages/runtime/src/domains/ai.ts` only dispatches `/ai/*` to the route table the AI service registers, and with no serveable AI service it answers 501. The only producer is cloud `service-ai` (`packages/service-ai/src/routes/ai-routes.ts`), which fills the member from `cost_weight` in a separate cloud card, `Blocked-by` this one. No framework number is invented.
- **Hook.** `useAiModels` keeps `costMultiplier` when it is what the spec declares (a finite positive number) and drops anything else, so a model never shows a multiplier it was not given.
- **Picker** (`ChatbotEnhanced`'s `ModelPicker`, the one picker every chat host renders):
  - each model with a multiplier draws `×N` beside its label, in the list and on the trigger; a model with none (or with a non-finite or non-positive value) draws none. The drawn value is rounded to two decimals at 1 and above and to two significant digits below 1, so a small multiplier never reads `×0`;
  - with usage served, the open list ends with a note: the share of the allowance left (`1 - pool.fraction`, as a percent, the same reading as the console's usage ring) and that a `×N` model uses it N times as fast as the default. Never a token count (rule D5). Without usage, or with no model carrying a multiplier, there is no note;
  - a pick whose DRAWN multiplier is ×20 or above opens an `AlertDialog` once, naming the model and its multiplier (and the share left, when known), so what the person reads and whether they are asked always agree (19.996 reads `×20` and asks). Cancel keeps the current model and writes nothing; "Switch model" writes the pick. The dialog holds the picked id and reads the model from the current list: a model that leaves the list while asked, or that the list now draws below ×20 or with no multiplier, is dropped, the question closes and nothing is written. A pick below ×20, or of a model with no multiplier, applies at once as before.
- **Hosts.** `ChatPane` (`AiChatPage.tsx`) reads `useAiUsage` only once some model carries a multiplier, and passes `pool.fraction` (not when unmetered or null) as `allowanceUsedFraction`. The `/ai` page, the console dock (`ChatDockConversation`) and the Studio copilot (`StudioCopilotConversation`) all render `ChatPane`, so none of their files changes and none can skip the confirmation.
- **Strings.** Six keys under `chatbot.modelPicker` in the existing `chatbot` namespace. en and zh-Hans (zh-CN) as ordered; the other nine packs are filled too, because `all-locales-key-parity.test.ts` requires every pack to define every `en` key.
- **Published surface, each a `Clause-②: yes (widening)`:**
  - `@objectstack/spec`: `AiModelsResponseSchema` model entry member `costMultiplier?: number`;
  - `@object-ui/plugin-chatbot`: `ChatbotModelOption.costMultiplier?: number`;
  - `@object-ui/plugin-chatbot`: `ChatbotEnhancedProps.allowanceUsedFraction?: number`.
- Changeset `.changeset/33660-ai-model-picker-cost-multiplier.md`: `@objectstack/spec`, `@object-ui/plugin-chatbot`, `@object-ui/i18n`, `@object-ui/app-shell`, `@object-ui/console` patch (a widening with `Metadata-protocol: none` ships `patch`; app-shell is private and console's `dist` ships it).
- Docs: one Features bullet on `content/docs/frontend/plugins/plugin-chatbot.mdx`.

## Tests

- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/ai/__tests__/AiChatPage.modelCostMultiplier-33660.test.tsx`: the three hosts (`AiChatPage` at `/ai/build`, `ChatDockConversation`, `StudioCopilotConversation`), each with the REAL `ChatPane`, `useAiModels`, `useAiUsage` (over a `fetch` stub answering `/ai/models` and `/ai/usage`) and `ChatbotEnhanced`, driven through the rendered `Select` (keyboard open, option click) and the rendered `AlertDialog`. Per host: `×1 ×5 ×20` drawn and nothing for the model the server gives none; a ×20 pick asks, Cancel keeps `Fast`, Confirm switches the trigger to the ×20 model; CONTROL: a ×5 pick switches at once with no dialog; the allowance note reads `60%` with usage `0.4`, and is absent when `/ai/usage` answers 404.
- `ui/packages/plugin-chatbot/src/__tests__/ChatbotEnhanced.modelCostMultiplier-33660.test.tsx`: the picker alone: multipliers per model and none for a model without one; the trigger's multiplier; a fractional `×0.5`; the edge (19.996 reads `×20` and asks, 19.994 reads `×19.99` and applies at once); `0.004` reads `×0.004`, and NaN, Infinity and 0 draw nothing; Confirm writes the asked-about model after the list reorders, a model that leaves the list while asked closes the question with nothing written and does not ask again when it returns; the same when its multiplier falls to ×5 or is withdrawn while asked; ×20 Cancel writes nothing, Confirm writes `opus` once; CONTROL: ×1, ×5 and no-multiplier picks write at once; the note and the dialog carry the share left with usage and only the multiplier without it; no note when no model has a multiplier.
- `packages/spec/src/api/protocol.test.ts`: an entry with `costMultiplier: 20` (and `0.5`) parses and keeps it; `0`, `-1`, `'20'` and `NaN` are refused; the existing entry without it still parses, as does the bare string.
- The existing picker pins (`ChatbotEnhanced.modelPicker-11865.test.tsx`, exact `textContent`) stay green unchanged: absent stays absent.
- Ablations through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (ui vitest aliases `@object-ui/plugin-chatbot` to `src`, no rebuild), each restored with the blob equal to HEAD and `git diff HEAD` empty:
  - on 0fcd2cfd, both new pin files (26 tests): no confirmation (the ×20 branch ANDed with an always-false term) 7 failed / 19 passed, every ×20 pin on all three hosts and the unit file; no rendering (the `×N` span's condition always false) 12 failed / 14 passed, every multiplier-drawn pin and the host pins that read the trigger's multiplier; the hook drops `costMultiplier` 15 failed / 11 passed, every host pin; `ChatPane` passes no `allowanceUsedFraction` 3 failed / 23 passed, the "note shows with usage served" pin on each host;
  - on 4d3ccb7c (the head's code; 35f32c7f only renames one test case), both pin files (31 tests): the ×20 question compares the raw value instead of the drawn one, 1 failed / 30 passed (the 19.996 edge pin); the drawn value rounds to two decimals below 1 too, 1 failed / 30 passed (`×0.004` reads `×0`); the line that drops a pick no longer asked about deleted, 3 failed / 28 passed (left the list, fell to ×5, withdrawn: each question comes back); the question keeps a model the list now draws below ×20 (`confirming` = the listed entry), 2 failed / 29 passed (fell to ×5, withdrawn).

## Acceptance notes

- **Patch round 1** (contract review PASS 6891993315 on 387c1794, three should-fixes; delta PASS 6892455683 on 098d07e5, one more): S1 the normalisation in the `.describe()` (reference docs regenerated); S2 the question compares the drawn value and nothing reads `×0`; S3 Confirm re-resolves the pick by id from the current list; delta: a pick whose model the list now draws below ×20 or with no multiplier is dropped too, so the question never reads "0 times". The optional nit on a non-finite multiplier from a direct host is in (draws nothing). Left as optional: the `×N` span sits inside the item text, so the trigger shows it too (intended: the person sees the multiplier of the model in force); and two `/ai/usage` reads where the console's usage ring is mounted beside the picker, since sharing one read needs a usage provider across the dock and the pane, outside this card's file surface.

- **Line budget.** About 826 changed lines at the head (the regenerated `protocol.mdx` excluded), over the order's ~600: 467 are the two pin files and 89 the i18n keys the parity test forces into all eleven packs. Production code is about 230. The seat agreed to keep ONE PR; a spec+hook / picker+hosts split would have left the second PR at about 680.
- **"Asks once"** is read as one confirmation per ×20-or-above pick (asked every time such a pick is made), not once per session.
- **The note's number is the share left, not used**, so it reads directly against the multiplier ("75% left; a ×N model uses it N times as fast"). It is derived only from `pool.fraction`; nothing estimates messages or tokens.
- **No cloud change.** Until cloud `service-ai` fills `costMultiplier`, every entry lacks it and the picker, the usage read and the confirmation are exactly as before (`useAiUsage` is not even asked).
- **Not changed:** the model list's filtering and plan gating, and how a pick is persisted (the order's ⛔).

## Verification
